spots.text: Please do not climb into the pictures.

secrets.name: The Room Inside the Frame
secrets.text: You climbed into a picture and came out of another one, into a little dark room hung with frames of its own. Some of them are pictures of the gallery. One of them is a picture of this room, with you in it, looking at a picture.

meta.label: The Gallery of Frames
meta.blurb: A gallery of gilded frames. Two of the pictures are of this gallery, from the other end, and in each of them hangs the other. Low in the far wall there is an empty frame, and it is dark inside, and it is big enough to climb into.
